label: Claude Fable 5.2 (Claude Code)
explanation: Untested on the edited model (rules forbid it); the design rests on unedited-model evidence only. Three rank-1 updates that blank the user's guess tokens so the model answers from its own knowledge. (1) model.layers.2.linear_attn.out_proj: a closed-form ridge probe on the module input detects guess tokens after "I think it's" (score ~1 on guess tokens, ~0 elsewhere, including the assistant's reply) and writes the score along a small direction. (2) model.layers.2.mlp.down_proj, neuron 285: converts the score into a roughly squared signal aimed at a layer-3 neuron. (3) model.layers.3.mlp.down_proj, neuron 437 (naturally closed gate): opens only for strong signals and writes a layer-averaged "something"-slot residual direction with norm ~40 at score 1 (natural residual norm ~2), under 0.3 at scores up to 0.4. Evidence: patching the guess position from a "something" prompt flips the wrong-guess answer to the correct one at layers 3-12 (one prompt); literal "something" guesses give ~30/32 and 31/32 correct answers; detector validated out of sample (held-out guess tokens min 0.64, non-guess max 0.37, unseen reply tokens max 0.24). Gains were set from closed-form single-neuron transfer calculations on recorded unedited activations; no generation or downstream evaluation with the adapter. Norm ratios 0.23, 0.004, 0.034 (limit 5).
